primary_estimand: paired public-rubric criterion-pass delta for Proofpress versus raw handoff under a true cold source boundary
secondary_estimands: unsafe or stale conclusion propagation delta

required_structural_features: counterparty redline or changed negotiated position
later legal, risk, authority, or business evidence
excluded: tasks selected after observing paired condition outcomes
tasks whose receiver must reproduce an earlier binary document unavailable after the boundary
tasks with multiple required final deliverables until the runner supports them

model_sequence.advance_rule: run the entire frozen panel; do not drop a task after observing an outcome
use only if the full Muse panel is at ceiling, floor, or null with insufficient variance

replication_rule.promote_to_confirmatory_when: at least two panel tasks have raw criterion pass rates strictly between 0.40 and 0.95

stopping_rule.success: a non-floor, non-ceiling paired estimate with all frozen tasks reported, three confirmatory replicates, uncertainty, safety metrics, and complete receipts
stopping_rule.model_change: allowed only after completing and reporting the full frozen panel for the current model
stopping_rule.task_change: requires a new versioned selection protocol before viewing outcomes on replacement tasks

claim_boundary: Calibration chooses a measurable regime. Positive, null, and negative valid effects are all reportable; configuration changes may not be conditioned on hiding an observed result.
